mcp.title: MCP
mcp.description: A library of MCP servers for this workspace. Adding one here gives it to no agent — an agent owner assigns it on the agent's own MCP tab, where it also gets a per-agent on/off toggle.
mcp.write_only_note: Saved configurations are write-only — urls, commands, headers, and environment values are never shown again, so editing a server replaces its configuration. Renaming is safe: agents keep their assignment.
mcp.empty_description: Add a server here, then assign it to the agents that should use it from their own MCP tab.
mcp.admin_only_note: Only workspace owners and admins can change the shared MCP servers.
mcp.delete_description: {{name}} will be removed from the library and from every agent it is assigned to, taking effect on their next run.
mcp.save_failed_toast: Could not save the shared MCP server
mcp.remove_failed_toast: Could not remove the shared MCP server

workspace.click_logo_hint: Click the logo to upload a new image
workspace.description_placeholder: What does this workspace focus on?
workspace.context_placeholder: Background information and context for AI agents working in this workspace
workspace.prefix_confirm_description: All issues will be renumbered from {{oldPrefix}}-N to {{newPrefix}}-N. External references — pull request titles, branch names, links in docs and chat — that use {{oldPrefix}}-N will stop resolving.
workspace.manage_hint: Only admins and owners can update workspace settings.
workspace.leave_sole_owner: You're the only owner. Promote another member to owner first, or delete the workspace.
workspace.leave_sole_member: You're the only member. Delete the workspace to leave.
workspace.leave_confirm_description: Leave {{name}}? You will lose access until re-invited.
workspace.delete_description: Permanently delete this workspace and its data.
workspace.plan_verification_label: Verify runs against the issue plan
workspace.plan_verification_description: After a run completes on an issue with a plan, queue a verification run and keep the issue out of Done while a critical divergence is reported.
workspace.decision_sla_deadline_description: A Decision Card left unanswered this long is escalated to the substitute, then, after the same delay, to the workspace owners and admins. 0 turns it off.
workspace.decision_sla_substitute_description: Who hears about an overdue card first. Without one, the owners and admins do.
workspace.ownership_description: A rule maps a path pattern (packages/core/billing/**) or a label to an owner and a referent agent. Issues that name a matching path or carry the label get them suggested; nothing is assigned without a click.
workspace.ownership_empty: No rule yet. Add the first one below.
workspace.briefing_enabled_description: Every member gets an inbox item each morning: done in the last 24 hours, awaiting review, blocked and why. It also lives in the inbox under “This morning”.
workspace.briefing_hour_description: Local hour and IANA timezone of the workspace.
workspace.briefing_send_description: Sends once per day; a second send says it was already sent.
workspace.briefing_failed: Failed to update the morning briefing
workspace.adr_gate_threshold_label: Files edited before a record is required
workspace.adr_gate_threshold_description: A run that edits at least this many files needs a recorded decision before its pull request is merge-ready. 0 turns this rule off.
workspace.adr_gate_migration_description: A run that edits a database migration needs a recorded decision, whatever its size.
workspace.adr_gate_failed: Failed to update decision records settings
workspace.rules_description: Write a rule in plain language. It is compiled once into a check you can read and try before it applies; active rules block their action with the rule's title and the observed facts.
workspace.rules_text_placeholder: e.g. An issue needs a description and at least one acceptance criterion before review
workspace.rules_attach_issue_submit_review: an issue is submitted for review
workspace.rules_dry_run_clean: Dry-run: nothing would be blocked today ({{count}} checked).
workspace.rules_dry_run_violations: Dry-run: {{count}} of {{checked}} would be blocked today.
workspace.rules_failed: The rule could not be saved
workspace.standup_enabled_description: Every day, an issue blocked or waiting for a decision longer than the threshold sends one question to its owner (module owner, else assignee, else creator).
workspace.standup_hours_description: How long an issue may stay blocked or waiting before someone is asked.
workspace.standup_retro_description: Every week, the runs of the last completed week are grouped with each agent's scorecard and sent to the owners and admins.
workspace.standup_failed: Failed to update the standup settings
workspace.rules_attach_webhook_received: a webhook delivery arrives in the triage queue
workspace.triage_auto_enabled_label: Let the queue apply confident suggestions
workspace.triage_auto_enabled_description: Every accept or dismiss teaches the queue. When on, a delivery whose nearest past decisions agree above the threshold is classified without a click, reversibly, and audited.
workspace.triage_auto_threshold_description: Share of the weighted vote the winning decision must reach, 50 to 100.
workspace.triage_auto_min_description: No auto-classification before this many human decisions exist.
workspace.triage_auto_failed: Failed to update the triage settings
workspace.gates_timeout_description: A blocked push, sensitive tool call or spend waits this long for an answer, then fails explicitly. It never runs on its own.
workspace.gates_spend_description: A run gets a short-lived spend token at once under this amount; above it, a Decision Card asks first.
workspace.gates_tools_description: Remote MCP tools whose name matches this regular expression pause for a human before they run.
workspace.gates_failed: Failed to update the approval gates
workspace.profiles_intro: What an agent may touch when it runs. Assign a profile on the agent (or on one run); the rules below are enforced where the runtime allows it (Claude deny rules, Codex read-only sandbox, approval gates) and told to the model otherwise.
workspace.profiles_denied_paths_description: Globs the run may neither read, edit nor push, comma separated. Example: .env, infra/**
workspace.profiles_allowed_commands_description: Commands the model is told it may run; * means anything.
workspace.profiles_hidden_secrets_description: Environment keys withheld from the run, as globs. Example: *PROD*, *_PASSWORD
workspace.profiles_failed: Failed to update the permission profile
workspace.pools_intro: A pool is an ordered family of interchangeable runtimes an agent fails over through when its runtime is offline or a run fails on infrastructure. The degraded runtime (a local model) is the explicit last resort, and any run landing there is flagged.
workspace.pools_degraded_hint: Order is preference. The degraded runtime only runs when every other runtime of the pool is unavailable, and the run says so.
workspace.pools_failed: Failed to save the runtime pool
workspace.routing_intro: Each new run goes to the pool of its risk level. Risk comes from the project's blast radius rules matched against the paths the issue names; nothing is inferred by a model.

routing_level_hints.normal: No rule matched, or paths inherit the project default.
routing_level_hints.high: A named path needs dual approval or is read-only; never the cheapest pool when a better one exists.

workspace.routing_escalation_description: After this many failed runs in a row on an issue, the next run goes one risk level up. 0 disables escalation.
workspace.routing_failed: Failed to save the routing policy
workspace.traffic_pause_description: A run editing files a human is changing in the daemon's checkout, or another run is editing, always lands in the Attention Inbox. Switch this on to also pause it at its next safe boundary.
workspace.drift_enabled: Stop a run that goes in circles
workspace.drift_intro: Watches each run's tool calls after they are written. A run repeating the same call, or re-reading the same file without writing to it, is stopped with the exact reason and lands in the Attention Inbox.
workspace.drift_repeated_description: Identical consecutive tool calls (same tool, same arguments) before the run is stopped.
workspace.drift_reread_description: Reads of the same file without a write in between before the run is stopped.
workspace.drift_failed: Failed to save the drift policy
workspace.pipelines_intro: An ordered chain of stages an issue moves through — each routed to an agent or a squad, with an optional human gate before it. The executor's completed run advances the issue; a gated stage waits on a Decision Card.
workspace.pipelines_template: Start from the triage → review template
workspace.pipelines_locked: Issues are moving through this pipeline: stages cannot change until their runs finish. The name can.
workspace.briefing_channels_description: Slack channel or Telegram chat ids the digest is posted to each morning, through the workspace's connected app. Narrated by the LLM when one is configured; structured either way.
workspace.competency_min_sample_description: Below this many outcomes (issues closed plus duels) an agent's success rate is shown as unreliable instead of a bare percentage.
workspace.competency_failed: Failed to save the competency settings

delete_workspace_dialog.description: This cannot be undone. All issues, agents, chats, and run history will be permanently removed.

github.page_description: Connect a GitHub App, control how Pull Requests show up inside Multica, and decide what your agents leave behind in commit history.

github.master_description_off: GitHub features are turned off. The PR sidebar, co-author trailer, and auto-link are paused. Data on the backend is not deleted.

github.connection_description_suffix: in its branch, title, or body is merged, the corresponding issue moves to

github.toast_not_configured: GitHub integration is not configured for this deployment
github.feature_pr_sidebar_description: Show linked pull requests inside the issue detail sidebar.

vcs.webhook_setup_description: Add a webhook on your repository or organisation with the URL and secret below. Forgejo/Gitea: choose the Gitea format and the Pull Request (and Commit Status) events. GitLab: paste the secret as the token and enable Merge request and Pipeline events.

vcs.rotate_confirm_description: The current webhook secret will stop working immediately. Deliveries from your Git provider will fail until you update the webhook secret in provider settings.

wecom.page_description: Connect each Multica Agent to its own WeCom (企业微信) smart bot. Members can DM the bot, @ it in groups, and type /issue to spin up a new Multica issue. The Agent replies over a long WebSocket connection, so no public callback URL is required.
wecom.not_enabled_description_suffix: on the server to enable WeCom smart-bot installations.
wecom.not_enabled_self_host_hint: Self-hosters: see the project README for details.
wecom.preview_description: The at-rest key is set, but this deployment has not fully enabled WeCom installs yet.
wecom.empty_description_prefix: Open an Agent in this workspace and click
wecom.empty_description_suffix: to install a smart bot for it.
wecom.disconnect_confirm_description: The bot will stop receiving WeCom messages for this workspace. The installation row is kept for audit; you can re-install later from the same Agent.
wecom.bind_button_title: Connect {{agent}} to a WeCom smart bot
wecom.agent_bot_disconnect_tooltip: Unbind this smart bot from the Agent. The bot will stop receiving WeCom messages.
wecom.byo_secret_placeholder: Paste the secret shown once in the console
wecom.byo_bot_name_hint: Only needed if the name has a space in it, so the bot can tell its own @-mention apart from the command typed after it. To change it later — including after renaming the bot in the WeCom console — disconnect this bot and connect it again.
wecom.byo_conflict_same_workspace: This bot is already connected to another Agent in this workspace. Disconnect it there first, then connect it here.
wecom.byo_conflict_archived_agent: This bot is connected to an archived Agent in this workspace. Restore that Agent, or disconnect its bot, before connecting it here.
wecom.byo_conflict_other_workspace: This bot is already connected to a different Multica workspace. Disconnect it there before connecting it here.
wecom.byo_rejected: Could not connect the bot. Check the Bot ID and secret from the WeCom admin console, and that it is a smart bot with the long connection enabled.
wecom.byo_credentials_rejected: WeCom rejected this Bot ID and secret. Check both on the WeCom admin console, and that it is a smart bot with the long connection enabled.
wecom.byo_credentials_unverifiable: Couldn't reach WeCom to verify this bot. Your credentials were not changed — try again in a moment.
wecom.byo_install_failed: Couldn't save this bot — something went wrong on our side. Your credentials were not changed; try again, and contact support if it keeps failing.
wecom.byo_failed_toast: Could not connect the WeCom bot

telegram.page_description: Connect each Multica Agent to its own Telegram bot. Members can DM the bot, @mention it in a group, type /issue to spin up a new Multica issue, and watch the agent's reply stream live.
telegram.not_enabled_description_suffix: on the server to enable Telegram bot installations.
telegram.not_enabled_self_host_hint: Self-hosters: see the project README for details.
telegram.preview_description: The at-rest key is set, but installs are not available in this deployment yet. The Connect button will appear here once they are.
telegram.empty_description_prefix: Open an Agent in this workspace and click
telegram.empty_description_suffix: to install a bot for it.
telegram.disconnect_confirm_description: The bot will stop receiving Telegram messages for this workspace. Chat history in Multica is kept; you can re-connect later from the same Agent.
telegram.agent_bot_disconnect_tooltip: Unbind this Telegram bot from the Agent. The bot will stop receiving Telegram messages.
telegram.agent_bot_manage_tooltip: Open a chat with this bot in Telegram.
telegram.connect_dialog_description: Create a bot with @BotFather in Telegram, then paste its token below. The token is verified live and stored encrypted.
telegram.connect_docs_link: Step-by-step: connect your Multica agent to Telegram
telegram.connect_failed_toast: Could not connect the Telegram bot

daemon.title: Daemon
daemon.description: Configure how the local agent daemon behaves with the desktop app.
daemon.signin_expired_description: The local daemon couldn't authenticate, so this device can't take runs. Sign in again to restore it.
daemon.external_description_before: This device's daemon runs outside the app — for example inside WSL2 — so the app can't start or stop it. Start or stop it from that environment with
daemon.auto_start_description: Start the daemon when you log in. While the app is open, it supervises both auto-started and manually started daemons.
daemon.auto_stop_description: Stop the daemon when the desktop app is closed. Disable this to keep the daemon running in the background.
daemon.cli_installed: multica CLI is installed and available in PATH.
daemon.cli_missing: multica CLI not found. Install it to enable daemon management.
daemon.diagnostics_description: Identification and connection details. Useful when filing a bug report or investigating why a runtime isn't showing up.
daemon.restarting_description: Runtimes will be back online in a few seconds.
daemon.stop_confirm_description_one: {{count}} run is currently active on this device. Stopping now will interrupt it — affected runs get marked failed once the timeout hits. The daemon won't auto-restart.
daemon.stop_confirm_description_other: {{count}} runs are currently active on this device. Stopping now will interrupt them — affected runs get marked failed once the timeout hits. The daemon won't auto-restart.
daemon.no_matching_logs_description: Try a different search or level toggle.
daemon.not_running_description: Start the daemon to see logs here.
daemon.waiting_logs_description: New entries will appear in real time.
daemon.try_again_moment: Please try again in a moment.
